module: Flowgraph node "Pursuit Parameters" (once_instant). Sets the police parameters (gameplay_police.setPursuitVars): policeStrictness (strictness), arrestLimit (arrestTime), arrestRadius, evadeLimit (evadeTime), evadeRadius, suspectFrequency, roadblockFrequency. Only non-nil pins are applied.

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

workOnce.desc: Builds the variables table from the non-nil pins and calls gameplay_police.setPursuitVars.
